<!--
FDIC-BRC / JFQA revision v4: maturity corroboration. Split banks at the
median of the PREDETERMINED 2022Q4 share of uninsured time deposits maturing
within 12 months ((HK12+HK13)/uninsured TDs) and re-estimate the baseline
uninsured-TD DiD in each half.
2026-08-08 (PDF comment round): now exported as Panel B of the main
time-deposit DiD table (tbl_maturity_split); prose numbers in
sections/results/empirical_results_current.tex must match.
Inputs: panel_smallbank (fallback vintage),
        td_maturity_2022q4_20260807.csv (01d_pull_td_maturity_20260807.py).
-->

```{r}
rm(list = ls())

library(data.table)
library(fixest)
library(here)

source(here::here("code", "_common.R"))
source(here::here("tracks", "fdic-brc-jfqa-aug2026", "code", "_track_common.R"))

save_tables <- TRUE

panel <- readRDS(latest_track_file("panel_smallbank"))
setDT(panel)
mat <- fread(file.path(TRACK_DATA, "td_maturity_2022q4_20260807.csv"))
setnames(mat, "IDRSSD", "ID_RSSD")

q4 <- panel[as.Date(D_DT) == as.Date("2022-12-31"),
            .(ID_RSSD, unins_td_22q4 = unins_time_deps)]
mat <- mat[q4, on = "ID_RSSD", nomatch = NULL]
mat[, short_share := fifelse(unins_td_22q4 > 0,
                             pmin((mat_lt3m + mat_3to12m) / unins_td_22q4, 1),
                             NA_real_)]
mat[, high_short := as.integer(short_share >= median(short_share, na.rm = TRUE))]

dt_w <- panel[abs(qtrs_since) < 12]
dt_w[, post := ifelse(qtrs_since > 0, 1, 0)]
dt_w[, D_DT := as.factor(as.Date(D_DT))]
dt_w[mat, on = "ID_RSSD",
     `:=`(short_share = i.short_share, high_short = i.high_short)]

setFixest_fml(
  ..ctrl = ~ log_total_assets_l1 + equity_assets_l1 + int_expense_assets_l1,
  ..fe = ~ ID_RSSD + D_DT
)

r <- list(
  "Full"          = feols(unins_time_deps_assets ~ post * high_cecl_equity + ..ctrl | ..fe,
                          dt_w, vcov = ~ID_RSSD),
  "High Maturity" = feols(unins_time_deps_assets ~ post * high_cecl_equity + ..ctrl | ..fe,
                          dt_w[high_short == 1], vcov = ~ID_RSSD),
  "Low Maturity"  = feols(unins_time_deps_assets ~ post * high_cecl_equity + ..ctrl | ..fe,
                          dt_w[high_short == 0], vcov = ~ID_RSSD),
  "Interaction"   = feols(unins_time_deps_assets ~ post * high_cecl_equity * high_short +
                            ..ctrl | ..fe, dt_w, vcov = ~ID_RSSD)
)
cat("\n================ MATURITY SPLIT (Panel B of Table 2) ================\n")
etable(r, keep = "post")

dict_mat <- c(covariate_labels_dict, "(Intercept)" = "Constant",
              "high_short" = "High Short-Maturity",
              "post:high_short" = "Post x High Short-Maturity",
              "post:high_cecl_equity:high_short" =
                "Post x High CECL x High Short-Maturity")
export_track_tbl(r, "tbl_maturity_split", dict_mat,
                 order = c("Post x High CECL x High Short-Maturity",
                           "Post x High CECL", "Post x High Short-Maturity"))

cat("\n================ DIAGNOSTICS ================\n")
cat("Banks with maturity data:", uniqueN(dt_w[!is.na(short_share), ID_RSSD]),
    "| high-CECL among them:",
    uniqueN(dt_w[!is.na(short_share) & high_cecl_equity == 1, ID_RSSD]), "\n")
cat("short_share (2022Q4, <=12m) pctiles:\n")
print(round(quantile(mat$short_share, c(.01, .25, .5, .75, .99), na.rm = TRUE), 3))
cat("median split value:", round(median(mat$short_share, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
```
